=== assert-failing
--- main
Alice -> Bob : hi
!assert 1 == 2 : "numbers differ"
=== assert-failing-no-message
--- main
!assert 1 == 2
=== assert-passing
--- main
!assert 1 == 1 : "ok"
A : after
=== assert-message-expression
--- main
!$n = 3
!assert $n > 5 : "n is " + $n
=== assert-string
--- main
!assert "" : "empty string"
=== assert-uppercase
--- main
!ASSERT 1 == 2
=== log-basic
--- main
!log hello world
!$x = 5
!log x is $x
A : after log
=== log-function
--- main
!function $f()
!return "F"
!endfunction
!log value $f()
=== dump-memory
--- main
!$b = 2
!$a = "one"
!dump_memory here
A : ok
=== dump-memory-in-function
--- main
!$g = 1
!procedure $p($arg)
!$loc = 2
!dump_memory inside
!endprocedure
$p("v")

=== bad-sub-in-function-body

=== deep-recursion
--- main
!function $r($n)
!if $n <= 0
!return 0
!endif
!return 1 + $r($n - 1)
!endfunction
A : $r(150)
=== infinite-recursion
--- main
!function $r($n)
!return $r($n + 1)
!endfunction
A : $r(1)
=== dollar-sign-text
--- main
A : $ $$ $1 cost $5
=== percent-text
--- main
A : 50% %unknown(1) %strlen
=== function-name-prefix
--- main
!function $ab()
!return "AB"
!endfunction
!function $abc()
!return "ABC"
!endfunction
A : $ab() $abc() $abcd()
=== variable-name-prefix
--- main
!$ab = "AB"
!$abc = "ABC"
A : $ab $abc $abcd $ab_
